purpose: Connect the existing reduced-history N4 receipt to the new native REI producer without transferring scientific admission between different models

existing_N4.admitted_inputs: Only the two frozen RUN002 reduced FLRW and r_i=+0.1 histories, mean-volume z=20 to 4
existing_N4.scope: Proper-time effective-density cells, fixed-time optical depth and finite-segment visibility

new_native_producer.progress_authority: Root integration owner reports; this consumer-link task does not rerun or independently revalidate the producer

reported_N2.metric_definitions_and_tolerances: Read the pinned producer contract and independent decision; these summary numbers do not define new thresholds

future_cell_contract.time: Contiguous increasing proper/normal seconds in the non-tilted material frame; bind the actual producer epoch origin and endpoints
future_cell_contract.density: Proper electron density in m^-3; no extra scale-factor, redshift or Doppler multiplier
future_cell_contract.instantaneous_electron_density: n_H*x_HII + n_He*(x_HeII + 2*x_HeIII), using the native history composition
future_cell_contract.quadrature_mean: ne_eff_i = integral_cell n_e(t) dt / (t1_i-t0_i), evaluated with and identified by the accepted producer quadrature
future_cell_contract.constants: Pin both producer and BASS c and sigmaT. If different, compare with their explicit ratio; do not silently reuse the old reduced-lane rho or rescale density
identity_required: Computed-history immutable commit and history payload hash
Actual source, gas, composition, temperature and photon closure contracts
Producer time quadrature and cell-exporter source hashes
Each emitted cell payload hash and exact epoch bounds
Selected BASS native receiver source and execution identity
future_cell_contract.closure_inheritance: No inheritance of the old R15/HG97 Case-B filling-factor closure into the new native history
future_cell_contract.new_acceptance: Freeze receiver criteria from its pinned contract before new execution; preserve producer gates and upstream N4 tolerances
future_cell_contract.parity_interpretation: Receiver integral parity checks the projection, constants, units and time binding; it is not independent validation of the producer history

scope_guards.segment_end_visibility: Only after a separate new native receipt; no probability renormalization

next_action: After the producer spectral diagnostic and scoped decision are recorded, export separately pinned native proper-time cells and execute a new BASS receiver acceptance; retain this old N4 receipt without replay
